releaseNotes: Logo aplikasi baru AturAjah dan antarmuka UI Layout Material murni bebas emoji di seluruh halaman. Catatan: jika sebelumnya terpasang v1.0.3 dan pembaruan gagal menimpa, hapus versi lama sekali saja lalu pasang APK v1.0.5.
releaseNotesEn: New AturAjah app logo and pure Material UI Layout across all screens with zero emoji. Note: if upgrading directly over v1.0.3 fails, uninstall v1.0.3 once and install the v1.0.5 APK.
